messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGER — High tail latency detected for /v1/generate in eu-west-2. p99 ~2.4s (SLO 500ms). Paging oncall@sre now. playbook: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/router-tail

devin: i'm on it. seeing p95 jump too, ~900ms. some streaming requests stall mid-response, looks like queueing on backends.

maria: router telemetry correlates spike with a routing rollout window. small subset of shards got >10x traffic (weight skew) under policy `route-by-affinity-v2` in euw2.

ashok: hot partitioning suspected. any recent routing weight rollout?

maria: yes — automated seeding started 06:22 UTC. checksum shows seeds applied. samples from router logs:
``n2026-03-15T06:22:18Z router-config: apply seed route-by-affinity-v2
2026-03-15T06:23:02Z router: peer weight assigned: shard-47 -> 0.86
2026-03-15T06:23:03Z router: peer weight assigned: shard-11 -> 0.86
2026-03-15T06:23:03Z telemetry: p99 up 2.4s
```

olivia: confirmed. streaming requests are landing on those overloaded pools -> KV cache thrash -> stalls for long-context streams. sample request ids: a1b2c3d4, c3d4e5f6.

sre-lead: immediate mitigation options: (1) halt/rollback rollout, (2) drain overloaded backends, (3) apply emergency routing override to smooth weights. prefer override + drain to keep system online.

devin: applying override now — routing-cli set-policy-override --policy route-by-affinity-v2 --zone euw2 --override uniform --duration 15m
``noverride-id: ov-20260315-001
```

sre-bot: ACTION: override applied ov-20260315-001 by devin at 06:29 UTC

maria: initiating drain of the hottest pools (shard-47, shard-11). commands:
``nrouter-admin drain-pool --pool shard-47 --zone euw2 --grace 120
router-admin drain-pool --pool shard-11 --zone euw2 --grace 120
```

nik: alerting CS + sales for impacted customers: AcmeMaps, VoyagerAI. prepping a short status message.

ashok: monitoring graphs now. initial improvement visible: p99 dropped 2.4s -> 720ms within 4m, p95 900ms -> 240ms.

olivia: streaming-stall rate decreasing. KV cache miss ratio on those shards down from 0.80 -> 0.12.

sre-lead: keep override for full 15m and observe. after that we can re-evaluate reapplying seeds only after fixing the seeding logic (probable bug: missing normalization step). assign eng-runtime for patch.

devin: filed GH issue runtime#4521 — "seed-normalization missing on policy rollout". linking logs and the override id.

maria: root cause hypothesis: rollout tool didn't normalize weights against zone capacity, resulting in 'ghost' high-weight assignments to a tiny subset -> hot partitions and tail amplification.

nik: customer impact summary (tentative): ~3% of requests in euw2 experienced >1s tail latency during window. top impacted tenants: AcmeMaps (tile gen slow), VoyagerAI (streaming partial responses). CS notified.

sre-lead: status: MITIGATING (override active, drains in progress). priority: high. cadence: updates every 10m. goal: p99 < 600ms for 10m before de-escalate.

devin: updating graphs here: https://grafana.redwood/d/routers/router-p99-euw2?from=now-30m

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — override ov-20260315-001 active. Escalation to eng-runtime requested.

olivia: added rollback & verification steps to the incident doc. playbook snippet: ensure per-shard entropy metric is healthy before reapply. :thumbsup:

sre-lead: post-incident follow-ups (to assign):
- fix seed normalization in rollout tool (eng-runtime)
- add canary checks for per-shard weight entropy (serving/observability)
- alert rule refinement: include per-shard skew and streaming-stall rate (observability)

nik: ack — i'll create the follow-up tickets and loop in CS reps for customer communications.

maria: current metrics at 06:48 UTC: p99 340ms, p95 130ms — looks stable. recommend close in 10m if no regression.

devin: will remove override at 06:54 UTC and reapply seeds only after runtime patch staged.

sre-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — override removed at 06:54:30 UTC, p99 within SLO for 15m post-change. Follow-ups opened: runtime#4521, obs#892, canary#110.

sre-lead: thanks all. schedule a short postmortem and include the seed rollout checklist update. closing live pager after documentation and customer notes are posted.

end of thread
